result.description:
About Us  

 Work where others holiday! ?? Just minutes from the ocean,  Flynns Beach Medical Centre  and  The Health Centre PMQ  are modern, community-focused clinics in beautiful Port Macquarie. 

 We're seeking a motivated  Practice Nurse- Skin (RN)  to join our team. 

   

  1. Position Purpose  

 The Practice Nurse – Skin is responsible for delivering high-quality, evidence-based nursing care within a primary care setting, with a focus on skin cancer prevention, early detection, and procedural support. The role supports medical practitioners in the assessment, diagnosis, and management of skin conditions, while promoting patient education and preventive health strategies. 

  2. Key Responsibilities  

  2.1 Clinical Practice  

 
	 
	 Undertake comprehensive skin assessments, including full-body skin checks (within scope of practice and under GP direction)  
	 
	 
	 Assist in the identification and documentation of suspicious lesions and skin abnormalities  
	 
	 
	 Perform dermoscopy assistance and clinical imaging where appropriately trained  
	 
	 
	 Provide wound care management, including dressings and suture removal  
	 
	 
	 Administer medications and vaccines in accordance with legislation, protocols, and competency  
	 
	 
	 Maintain accurate, contemporaneous clinical documentation in line with medico-legal requirements  
	 
 

   

  2.2 Procedural Assistance  

 
	 
	 Prepare patients and clinical rooms for skin procedures (biopsies, excisions, cryotherapy)  
	 
	 
	 Assist medical practitioners during procedures using aseptic technique  
	 
	 
	 Ensure correct handling, labelling, and dispatch of pathology specimens  
	 
	 
	 Monitor patients pre- and post-procedure and respond to clinical deterioration if required  
	 
 

   

  2.3 Patient Education & Preventive Health  

 
	 
	 Educate patients on sun protection, skin cancer awareness, and self-examination techniques  
	 
	 
	 Support national and practice-based preventive health initiatives  
	 
	 
	 Provide clear pre- and post-procedure instructions and follow-up care advice 
	 
 

   

  2.4 Care Coordination & Administration  

 
	 
	 Manage recall and reminder systems for results, follow-ups, and routine skin checks  
	 
	 
	 Liaise with pathology providers and ensure timely follow-up of results  
	 
	 
	 Support telehealth and digital health systems, including secure data handling  
	 
	 
	 Contribute to efficient patient flow and appointment coordination  
	 
 

   

  2.5 Infection Prevention & Control  

 
	 
	 Adhere to infection prevention and control policies consistent with the Royal Australian College of General Practitioners Standards for General Practices  
	 
	 
	 Maintain sterilisation processes and equipment in accordance with Australian guidelines  
	 
	 
	 Ensure clinical areas are clean, stocked, and compliant with accreditation requirements  
	 
 

  Apply Now
